newsitem.title: CHILE: MERCOSUR BLOC WORKS BETTER THAN NAFTA - MENEM.
newsitem.headline: MERCOSUR BLOC WORKS BETTER THAN NAFTA - MENEM.

text.p: South America's Mercosur customs union is working better than the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), Argentine President Carlos Menem said on Friday.
"In many opportunities I have been asked when the Mercosur is going to integrate into NAFTA," Menem said a joint news conference with Chilean President Eduardo Frei.

"I have told people that we are working better than NAFTA, so the question is when will NAFTA join the Mercosur?" he said, referring to the free-trade pact linking Canada, Mexico and the United States that went into effect three years ago.
Menem said Mexico and Canada have asked to link up with the Mercosur bloc, which groups Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay. Chile is an associate member.
"It must be for something that Mexico is asking to join the Mercosur. Here everything is working very well," he said.

The Argentine president was speaking on the second day of an official visit to Chile. during which he and Frei officially opened the GasAndes natural gas pipeline running from the Argentine city of Mendoza to Santiago.
